Regular feedback from patients will help healthcare providers understand their needs and preferences better, leading to improved care experiences.

6. Training and Support: Provide ongoing training and support for healthcare professionals to ensure they are comfortable using new technologies and adapting to a patient-centric model. This will foster a culture of innovation and continuous improvement within the organization.
